data.evidence_scope: v1 visual-identity-core + wiki visual-guidelines + brand-config preferred_colors. Existing assets must be respected (F3).
data.strategy: Precision meets regulatory authority. Minimal color mood; Signal Green used sparingly for validation/CTA.

signal_green.name: Signal Green
signal_green.psychology: Validation, go-signal, correctness. Confidence and action.
signal_green.usage: CTAs, success/validation states, sparse accents — never large floods of green

regulatory_stone.name: Regulatory Stone
regulatory_stone.role: secondary / primary text and dark surfaces
regulatory_stone.usage: Headings, body on light, dark footers/sections

clean_white.name: Clean White
clean_white.usage: Page backgrounds, breathing room in dense regulatory UI

caution_amber.name: Caution Amber
caution_amber.usage: Warnings, pending validation states — not marketing decoration

avoid_colors.reason: Generic blue corporate SaaS — brand-config avoid_colors

usage_rules: Green on white for primary actions and success states
Stone on white for body text and headings
White on stone for dark sections or footers
Green + stone never compete for attention on the same element
Test contrast in implementation; this receipt is not an accessibility certification
guardrails: Do not expand palette for campaign novelty without identity review
Do not borrow Hellio/Effy consumer-bright conventions
Respect existing logo-icon / og / hero assets (ASSET-ORIGINS)
